scope: Schema-valid metadata profiles, not a claim that all provider products, rows or bytes are verified.

gaps.reason: Recent slices are revisable and no release version is asserted by the inspected headers.
gaps.impact: Do not label the entire collection final or invent v1.5.
gaps.next_action: Inspect status attributes on each retrieved annual file and archive its metadata/hash.

gaps.reason: PDSI, SPI/SPEI/EDDI and elevation are outside this daily profile; the existing temporal enum lacks a five-day member.
gaps.impact: The sixteen daily variables do not imply coverage of all gridMET variants.
gaps.next_action: Create separate verified product profiles; review the existing enum extension proposal rather than call five-day output daily.

gaps.reason: local_midnight alone does not encode fixed MST/UTC-07; archived sample ending_1200_gmt conflicts with current provider evidence.
gaps.impact: Consumers must read the explicit MST convention; this is not station-local civil midnight.
gaps.next_action: Reuse description now; review a structured timezone/day-offset addition before automated temporal joins.

gaps.reason: Daily files can have multiple Sample Duration, Pollutant Standard, Event Type and POC combinations. Existing catalog has no typed selection profile.
gaps.impact: Parameter identity alone does not authorize combining rows; ozone rolling-average summaries are not raw daily ozone means.
gaps.next_action: Select an analysis-specific combination and retain these fields; consider scoped selection metadata only if executable catalog-driven selection is required.

gaps.reason: Datum varies per row; overall start date and a universal quality/certification state are not established.
gaps.impact: No EPSG:4326 default, guessed coverage start or unconditional quality_controlled/final value is supplied.
gaps.next_action: Read Datum and station metadata, resolve dates/offsets by monitor, and assess the requested annual file.

gaps.reason: Seven common pollutant parameters only; hourly files, grouped parameters and the authenticated API are separate profiles.
gaps.impact: This is not a complete inventory of every AQS parameter.
gaps.next_action: Extend from the official parameter table, with validated units and separate temporal/access profiles.

gaps.reason: Existing temporal enum cannot distinguish daily file organization from variable-duration imagery intervals.
gaps.impact: The daily product label must not be interpreted as continuous daily observation coverage.
gaps.next_action: Use feature Start/End for scientific time support; review an irregular-support enum/descriptor before automated temporal queries.

gaps.reason: Raw encodings and density completeness vary historically; no archive-wide fill sentinel or release version is verified.
gaps.impact: Do not map 5/16/21 to measured concentration or infer no smoke from unavailable data.
gaps.next_action: Inspect the requested archive date and preserve unmatched labels and observation availability.

gaps.reason: Native WGS84 Albers has no verified external authority code in the source metadata. The schema requires a code-like crs even when proj_string is present.
gaps.impact: AMADEUS:100001 is explicitly a catalog-local registration identifier; srid and unverified affine origin are omitted. Do not send 100001 or fallback 4326/5070 to ST_SetSRID.
gaps.next_action: Resolve the exact existing proj_string with PROJ/terra; before database ingestion, define an explicit CRS/SRID policy or relax the schema to permit a verified full CRS without an authority code.

gaps.reason: C1V1 is deliberately pinned; the provider now lists C1V2. Only the C1V1 Land Cover archive XML was read directly; the other five profiles use the official shared guide.
gaps.impact: No latest-release claim or successful current-download claim for all years/products is made.
gaps.next_action: Inspect requested product/year header, checksums, classes and C1V1 availability before execution; register C1V2 separately after review.

gaps.reason: Download/process recognize six products, but generic categorical extraction is not scientific validation of confidence, transitions, impervious fraction or spectral dates.
gaps.impact: Only land cover carries calculate_covariates dispatch in these specs.
gaps.next_action: Verify each product-specific extraction policy; use nearest for classes, area fractions for land cover, weighted means for impervious fraction and appropriate event handling for change DOY.

gaps.reason: Detailed government-source terms, native bounds, bit vocabularies and some release/coverage information lack exact implemented slots or verified values.
gaps.impact: No unsupported SPDX identifier, plausible physical bound, OMOP binding, dataset version, quality status or fake asset checksum is created.
gaps.next_action: Retain source statements in descriptions/notes; adopt only reviewed catalog extensions. Acquire actual assets before claiming byte-level validation.

gaps.reason: The source row correctly distinguishes nominal twice-yearly bulk publication from daily database updates. The EPA page itself contains differing month descriptions.
gaps.impact: P6M is nominal frequency only, not an exact calendar or availability guarantee.
gaps.next_action: Use actual annual-file modification dates; resolve month-specific release claims with EPA if needed.

gaps.field: programme contribution history vs smoke support
gaps.reason: The workbook B5:F25 table covers programme systems, including dates before smoke polygons began. In use and chart endpoint values do not establish final contribution dates.
gaps.impact: Twenty-one paired source assertions are preserved in DataSource.description; none is asserted as a smoke-product-specific sensor/date relationship.
gaps.next_action: Verify historical programme assertions and smoke-specific participation before typed contribution queries; do not introduce ambiguous scalar Product fields.

gaps.field: first-release, rights, lifecycle and coverage vocabulary
gaps.reason: All relevant inventory assertions are retained as attributed, scoped text. Dedicated proposed slots/enums have not been incorporated into the existing schema.
gaps.impact: Metadata is preserved but not uniformly available as structured filter fields. Inventory claims do not become verified release dates, SPDX terms, implementation status or observation QA.
gaps.next_action: Approve only justified extensions from the final Markdown gap review if typed queries are required; otherwise use the existing descriptions and audit trace.

gaps.field: legacy and Tree Canopy Cover scope
gaps.reason: The workbook mixes legacy citations/years with Annual status and lists Tree Canopy Cover under multiple themes. Neither establishes a new verified Annual C1V1 product.
gaps.impact: Legacy and canopy information is retained in scope decisions rather than copied into Annual records or registered twice.
gaps.next_action: Verify and register these distinct product families only when expanding the stated scope.
